item.title: Schwarber homers and Henderson gets 4 hits to lead United States over Britain 9-1 at WBC
item.description: Kyle Schwarber hit a two-run homer and Gunnar Henderson had four hits and two RBIs as the United States rolled to a 9-1 victory over Britain on Saturday night at the World Baseball Classic .

item.title: Farabee leads Flames to 5-4 win over Hurricanes
item.description: CALGARY — Joel Farabee scored twice, including his team-leading 15th goal, and had an assist to lead the Flames to a 5-4 NHL victory over the Carolina Hurricanes on Saturday.

item.title: Whitecaps topple Timbers 4-1 in Cascadia Cup rivalry match
item.description: PORTLAND, Ore. (AP) — Brian White scored twice and the Vancouver Whitecaps beat the rival Portland Timbers 4-1 on Saturday night in a Cascadia Cup rivalry match.

item.title: Canadian women look to reframe rugby sevens identity
item.description: VANCOUVER — Nearly two years after winning silver at the Paris Olympics, Canada’s women’s rugby seven squad is in what head coach Jocelyne Barrieau describes as a "framing year." “Last year was our foundational year,” she said Saturday.

item.title: Horvat scores winner in OT as Islanders edge Sharks 2-1
item.description: SAN JOSE, Calif. (AP) — Bo Horvat scored with 39.6 seconds left in overtime, lifting the New York Islanders to a 2-1 win over the San Jose Sharks on Saturday night.

item.title: Senators pull away with four-goal spree, beat Kraken 7-4
item.description: SEATTLE (AP) — Shane Pinto had a goal and two assists in Ottawa's four-goal spree in the first and second periods and the Senators beat the Seattle Kraken 7-4 on Saturday night.

item.title: Arvidsson’s breakaway winner lifts Bruins past Capitals for a 12th straight home win
item.description: Viktor Arvidsson scored the go-ahead goal on a breakaway 4:28 into the third period and the Boston Bruins beat the Washington Capitals 3-1 on Saturday for their 12th straight home victory.
